evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded CRUD-style functionality with specified inputs; can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Specific mechanism (URL) and scope (invitation/access) are clear enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped UI behavior with explicit input field type; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: A session item list display is a common, bounded feature; not overly broad.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Single interaction (select item) with clear outcome (team sees item); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Simple add-to-list behavior; bounded and can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard edit operation on an item; scope is clear enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Standard delete operation; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Specific behavior toggle/trigger; implementation scope is clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Defined computation (average) and action (accept); bounded feature.

evaluations.evidence: filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Clear condition and outcome; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simple data entry action with clear purpose; bounded.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation within session is a clear, bounded capability; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: “Import from a spreadsheet” is underspecified (file formats, mapping, validation, error handling), making effort hard to estimate without further clarification.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste import is underspecified (expected columns/format, parsing rules, multi-line handling), leading to uncertain scope for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: “Browse” is broad and could imply search, filtering, pagination, sorting, and access control; scope is not bounded enough for reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: “Transcript” content and presentation are not defined (what events, formatting, navigation), making the feature potentially coarse-grained and hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export to a specific format (HTML file) is a bounded deliverable; can be estimated even if exact layout is flexible.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export is a well-understood, bounded capability; estimatable with reasonable assumptions.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear delete behavior and scope (game and its data); estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Specified fields and action; standard registration feature is estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Standard login behavior; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: “Account details” is vague (which fields, constraints, verification flows), making scope uncertain for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Clear action and data scope; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Specific transformation/display requirement; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Common password reset/reminder flow; sufficiently bounded to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Explicit options and behavior; bounded configuration feature.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Clear quantitative limit and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Specific join mechanism and input; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Simple display requirement; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: List display for estimators; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Clear UI feedback requirement; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Specific reveal condition and behavior; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Clear boundary condition for when changes are allowed; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Defined data to display (prior estimates per estimator for current story); bounded enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Clear reporting/display for current round; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Specific duration and shared visibility; bounded feature.

evaluations.evidence: timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger and behavior; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: UI navigation through prior rounds is reasonably bounded; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Specific consistency requirement for ordering; bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Clear condition (draw not completed) and action; estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI element and placement intent; bounded enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Compliance “with standards” across an entire site is broad and potentially open-ended, making it hard to estimate as a single story.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Scope is unclear (which terms, how many, where maintained, format/governance), making effort difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: “As fast as possible” implies open-ended optimization and unclear scope (which queries, targets), making estimation unreliable.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-browser “function correctly” for the whole application is very broad and potentially large; difficult to estimate as one story.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance across the site with “where possible” is open-ended and hard to bound for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Non-specific performance requirement without measurable targets or scope; too vague to estimate reliably.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode, so that I can use any language I like
evaluations.rationale: “Use Unicode” can span storage, UI, input validation, exports, and integrations; scope is broad and underspecified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: “Sensible and predictable” is subjective and could require broad routing/IA changes; insufficiently bounded to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: “Nice error pages” and “when something goes wrong” are vague and potentially cover many error scenarios; hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Non-identifiable storage can imply complex anonymization/pseudonymization decisions and threat models; scope is underspecified for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: “Some metrics” is undefined (which metrics, time ranges, dashboards, aggregation), making the requirement too vague to estimate.
